title: Survival analysis with lung, colon, and TCGA data
summary: A practical BioLang companion covering every exercise and figure through BDSR section 9.3.1.2: censoring, Kaplan-Meier curves, log-rank tests, Cox models, risk tables, TCGA expression, and pan-kidney survival.

source.title: Stephen D. Turner, Ph.D. — Biological Data Science with R: Survival analysis
source.note: Independent OriClabs BioLang companion under MIT. It follows the public topic order but does not copy or relicense upstream prose, R code, tables, or figures. Dataset files retain their separate upstream terms. This is not an official BDSR publication or endorsement.
